summary.text: Macey Budke, who works in behavioral health management in North Platte, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Nebraska's 3rd Congressional District to Adrian Smith after running on the Nebraska Working People Party line.
She describes herself as an Independent candidate and holds master's degrees in psychology and healthcare administration.

paragraphs.text: Budke says she grew up in rural Nebraska and that her work focuses on helping rural communities access quality care.
The Nebraska Examiner describes her as a registered nonpartisan write-in candidate, while Ballotpedia lists her ballot line as the Nebraska Working People Party.
She received 2.8% of the vote to Adrian Smith's 71%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
